complete.label: Complete
complete.description: Every rule, screen and file format of the original is in the rebuild, except where a recorded deviation changes it.

high-fidelity-playable.label: High-fidelity playable
high-fidelity-playable.description: Playable start to finish, with every screen in place and at least two thirds of the rules and screens matching the original in full.

limited-fidelity-playable.label: Limited-fidelity playable
limited-fidelity-playable.description: Playable start to finish, but much of it only approximates the original.

early-prototype.label: Early prototype
early-prototype.description: Work has started, and the game cannot be played through yet.
